agent_priors_used: Prior: Long-horizon agents accumulate path dependence multiplicatively; early routing errors dominate later cost so inheritance without dependency scoping or early verification cannot compress work — distinguished from SPIDER evidence which only shows orthogonality correlation, not cost compression.

Prior: LLM agents overweight salient prior context and underweight invalidation signals; without calibrated UNKNOWN abstention they prefer false-accept over abstain, explaining why ECE<=0.15 and UNKNOWN precision>=0.85 gates are essential — not yet established by SPIDER product trials.

Prior: Marginal information gain decays after 2-3 estimator variants on same synthetic DGP; orthogonal levels of description (visual/a11y/program synthesis/process mining) have higher expected information than an 11th divergence estimator — distinguishes from SPIDER's 10+ synthetic TV/KDE/kNN results which remain synthetic-only.

Prior: Caching/replay baselines are extremely strong on repeated tasks; SPIDER work-compression only interpretable vs strong retrieval/RAG/instruction baselines at equal model/tools/budget, not vs cold/naive replay — distinguishes from prior synthetic POCs that used simulated baselines.

Prior: Compound LLM systems fail more on infrastructure/stealth/session than planning at SOTA; separating browser/network/session validity from semantic correctness is required for measurement validity — informs Runtime session-affinity priority, not SPIDER-established production CDN fact.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: SPIDER at 247 canonical experiments is substrate-rich but claim-poor: only C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE has clean momentum (3 consecutive SURVIVES via non-oracle reconstruction on synthetic + live WebShop/ALFWorld), C-MEAS-VALID expanded to production loopback gunicorn+nginx EXPERIMENTAL, C-FRESHNESS orthogonality empirically real (r~0.02-0.04 TOST p~2e-08) but blocked on distributed session replication (TN 0.667 vs 0.85), while central promises C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-PARAM-INHERIT remain HYPOTHESIS/MEASUREMENT_INVALID with no discriminating test of later-agent cost tracking residual novelty vs strong replay/RAG baselines, and C-WEB-DYNAMICS/C-CROSSSITE stalled on 0/3 Gate0 real-SPA enumeration after 62+21 experiments. Highest leverage is (a) consolidate semantic-resolve SURVIVES before narrowing and port to product, (b) pay one-time distributed session-affinity cost to unblock freshness/delta-repair, (c) force the missing residual-novelty work-compression test with real LLM+Playwright vs strong baselines, and (d) pivot physics/intel away from exhausted synthetic TV and exhaustive Docker enumeration toward orthogonal mechanisms and curated live benchmarks (Online-Mind2Web/Web Bench) plus Skyvern replay baseline.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: Scout brief correctly diagnosed substrate-rich/claim-poor state, identified C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE as only SURVIVES momentum, flagged Freshness orthogonality real but detection-fidelity blocked on session replication, highlighted Online-Mind2Web/WebJudge shortcut inflation (90%->22% collapse) and Skyvern code-caching as the naive product to beat, and proposed pivoting Intel to curated benchmarks and Physics/Frontier away from synthetic estimators. Direction accepts Scout's exploitation of semantic-resolve window, its one-time session-affinity payment, and its Skyvern baseline imperative, but challenges Scout's suggestion to immediately reopen C-FRESHNESS distributed orthogonality in Graph: that fix is reassigned to Runtime as substrate provider, freeing Graph to fill the more central missing residual-novelty gap. Scout's broad reconnaissance was used for prioritization, not as evidence.
